__comment: Packet B7-2 / BUGS.md SKB-016: the tail countdown baked into _is_playing, in its PESSIMISTIC form. This Delay exposes both delayTime and feedback, so a runtime set_param can move either one, and the codegen therefore has to assume each parameter's RANGE MAXIMUM rather than its authored 0.25s / 0.3 — otherwise the countdown would expire while a game-raised feedback was still ringing. The golden pins the consequence: Asset_BUS_TAIL_SECONDS = 270.0 (delayTime max 2.0s x the 135 passes it takes feedback 0.95 to fall 60dB), where the same patch with nothing exposed would bake 1.5s. That is the documented cost of exposing a tail parameter over its full range.
